question: Who authored the book ‘Voices of Dissent’ published in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Romila Thapar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A book titled “Voices of Dissent” authored by Romila Thapar**.
 
• This book is scheduled to be published in October 2020.
 
• In Voices of Dissent: **Thapar looks at the articulation of nonviolent dissent and relates it to various pivotal moments throughout India's history.**
 
• It also **focuses on the recent protests in India against the Citizenship Act and the National Register of Citizens.**
 
• **Romila Thapar hails from Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• Her works include **A History of India (1966), Interpreting Early India (1992), Early India: From the Origin to AD 1300(2003).**
 
• She was **awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2005 and received the Kluge Award in December 2008**.
